description: Calculate the periodic mortgage payment for a Canadian home. Call it ONE of two ways: (a) if the user gave a PURCHASE PRICE, pass homePrice + downPayment and CMHC insurance is applied when the down payment is under 20%; (b) if the user gave a MORTGAGE / LOAN AMOUNT (e.g. "payment on a $500,000 mortgage"), pass loanAmount on its own. Do NOT invent a purchase price in order to reach a loan amount — use loanAmount. Inventing a price changes the answer by several percent and attaches a CMHC premium the user does not owe.

amortizationYears.description: Amortization in years (max 25 insured, 30 uninsured/first-time new builds)

annualInterestRatePct.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 5.25

downPayment.description: Down payment amount in CAD (or percent if downPaymentType='percent'). Required when homePrice is used.

homePrice.description: Purchase price in CAD, e.g. 650000. Use with downPayment. Omit if the user gave you the mortgage amount instead.

loanAmount.description: The mortgage amount itself in CAD, when the user stated the loan rather than the purchase price. Mutually exclusive with homePrice. No CMHC premium is applied on this path — the amount is taken as the principal.

province.description: Province name, used only for CMHC PST on the premium

name: mortgage_payment
title: Canadian Mortgage Payment Calculator
